transcript_turns.text: I can tell you from personal experience that I was in the hospital, I had it.

transcript_turns.text: And I got better and I will tell you that I had something that they gave me — a therapeutic, I guess they would call it.

transcript_turns.text: All over the world, thousands and thousands a month, distributing them all over the world, it will go away and as I say, we’re rounding the turn, we’re rounding the corner, it’s going away.

transcript_turns.text: What I would do is make sure we have everyone encouraged to wear a mask, all the time.

transcript_turns.text: I would make sure we move in the direction of rapid testing, investing in rapid testing.

transcript_turns.speaker: Joe Biden
transcript_turns.text: I would make sure that we set up national standards as to how to open up schools and open up businesses so they can be safe, and give them the wherewithal and financial resources to be able to do that.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: And this is a very easy distribution for him.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: He’s ready to go as soon as we have the vaccine, and we expect to have 100 million vials as soon as we have the vaccine, he’s ready to go.

transcript_turns.speaker: Joe Biden
transcript_turns.text: We’re about to go into a dark winter, a dark winter, and he has no clear plan and there’s no prospect that there’s going to be a vaccine available for the majority of the American people before the middle of next year.

transcript_turns.text: I don’t think we’re going to have a dark winter at all.

transcript_turns.text: We’re opening up our country.

transcript_turns.text: We’ve learned and studied and understand the disease, which we didn’t at the beginning.

transcript_turns.text: But it was a total disaster.

transcript_turns.text: Had that had this kind of numbers, 700,000 people would be dead right now, but it was a far less lethal disease.

transcript_turns.text: And he did it late, after 40 countries had already done that.

transcript_turns.text: We owe him a debt of gratitude.

transcript_turns.text: We have to thank him.

transcript_turns.text: And then what happened was, we started talking about using the Defense Act, to make sure we go out and get whatever is needed out there to protect people.

transcript_turns.text: People can’t do that.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: I’d love to put myself in the basement or in a beautiful room in the White House and go away for a year and a half until it disappears.

transcript_turns.text: I can’t do that.

transcript_turns.text: 99% of people recover.

transcript_turns.text: Number one.

transcript_turns.speaker: Joe Biden
transcript_turns.text: He says that we’re, you know, we’re learning to live with it.

transcript_turns.text: Learning to live with it?

transcript_turns.text: Come on.

transcript_turns.speaker: Joe Biden
transcript_turns.text: We’re dying with it, because he’s never said — he said it’s dangerous.

transcript_turns.text: When’s the last time?

transcript_turns.text: Is it really dangerous, still?

transcript_turns.text: A whole range of things the President said.

transcript_turns.text: And even today, he thinks we are in control.

transcript_turns.speaker: Joe Biden
transcript_turns.text: We’re about to lose 200,000 more people.

transcript_turns.text: Now he says I should have closed it earlier.

transcript_turns.text: No.

transcript_turns.text: Oh no, I’m not shutting down the nation but there are, look, they need standards.

transcript_turns.text: Do not open until you get this under control, under more control.

transcript_turns.text: But when you do open, give the people the capacity to be able to open and have the capacity to do it safely.

transcript_turns.text: For example schools — schools, they need a lot of money to open.

transcript_turns.speaker: Joe Biden
transcript_turns.text: They need to deal with ventilation systems, they need to deal with smaller classes, more teachers, more pods, and he’s refused to support that money, or at least up to now.

transcript_turns.text: Well, I think we have to respond, if I might.

transcript_turns.text: Thank you, and I appreciate that.

transcript_turns.text: Look, all he does is talk about shutdowns but forget about him.

transcript_turns.text: And he supports all these people.

transcript_turns.text: We have to open our country.

transcript_turns.text: You know I’ve said it often — the cure cannot be worse than the problem itself, and that’s what’s happening, and he wants to close down.

transcript_turns.text: Simply not true.

transcript_turns.text: We’re gonna be able to walk and chew gum at the same time.

transcript_turns.text: We ought to be able to safely open, but they need resources to open.

transcript_turns.text: You need to be in a position where you can take testing rapidly and know whether a person is, in fact, infected.

transcript_turns.speaker: Joe Biden
transcript_turns.text: You need to be able to trace.

transcript_turns.speaker: Joe Biden
transcript_turns.text: You need to be able to provide all the resources that are needed to do this and that is not inconsistent with saying that we’re going to make sure that we open safely.

transcript_turns.text: And by the way, all you teachers out there — not that many of you are going to die, so don’t worry about it.

transcript_turns.speaker: Joe Biden
transcript_turns.text: Don’t worry about it.

transcript_turns.text: Come on.

transcript_turns.text: These are businesses that are dying, Joe, you can’t do that to people, you just can’t.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump

transcript_turns.text: Take a look at what New York has done in terms of turning the curve down, in terms of the number of people dying.

transcript_turns.speaker: Joe Biden
transcript_turns.text: It’s the fastest growing jobs and they pay good prevailing wages, 45, 50 bucks an hour.

transcript_turns.speaker: Joe Biden
transcript_turns.text: We can grow and we can be cleaner, if we go the route I’m proposing.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: Excuse me.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: We are energy independent for the first time.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: We don’t need all of these countries that we had a fight, war over because we needed their energy.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: We are energy independent.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: I know more about wind than you do.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: It’s extremely expensive, kills all the birds, it’s very intermittent.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: It’s got a lot of problems and they happen to make the windmills in both Germany and China.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: And the fumes coming up — if you’re a believer in carbon emission, the fumes coming up to make — make these massive windmills is more than anything that we’re talking about with natural gas, which is very clean.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: One other thing —

transcript_turns.speaker: Joe Biden
transcript_turns.text: Find me a scientist that says that.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: Solar.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: I love solar, but solar doesn’t quite have it yet.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: It’s not powerful enough yet to — to really run our big beautiful factories that we need to compete with the world —

transcript_turns.speaker: Joe Biden
transcript_turns.text: False.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: So, it’s all a pipe dream, but you know what we’ll do?

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: We’re gonna have the greatest economy in the world.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: But if you want to kill the economy, get rid of your oil industry.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: You want – and what about fracking?

transcript_turns.speaker: Joe Biden
transcript_turns.text: I have never said I oppose fracking.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: You said it on tape.

transcript_turns.speaker: Joe Biden
transcript_turns.text: I did?

transcript_turns.speaker: Joe Biden
transcript_turns.text: Show the tape.

transcript_turns.speaker: Joe Biden
transcript_turns.text: Put it on your website.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: I’ll put it on.

transcript_turns.speaker: Joe Biden
transcript_turns.text: Put it on the website.

transcript_turns.speaker: Joe Biden
transcript_turns.text: The fact of the matter is he’s flat lying.

transcript_turns.speaker: Joe Biden
transcript_turns.text: I do rule out banning fracking because the answer we need — we need other industries to transition to get to, ultimately, a complete zero emissions by 2025.

transcript_turns.speaker: Joe Biden
transcript_turns.text: What I will do with fracking over time is make sure that we can capture the emissions from the fracking.

transcript_turns.speaker: Joe Biden
transcript_turns.text: Capture the emissions from gas.

transcript_turns.speaker: Joe Biden
transcript_turns.text: We can do that and we can do that by investing money into — it’s a transition to that.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: Excuse me.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: He was against fracking.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: He said it.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: I will show that to you tomorrow.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: ‘I am against fracking’, until he got the nomination, went to Pennsylvania, then he said — you know what, Pennsylvania?

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: He’ll be against it very soon because his party is totally against it.

transcript_turns.speaker: Joe Biden
transcript_turns.text: Fracking on federal land, I said, no fracking and oil on federal land —

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: The families that we’re talking about are employed heavily and they are making a lot of money, more money than they’ve ever made.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: If you look at the kind of numbers that we produce for Hispanic, or Black, or Asian, it’s nine times greater, the percentage gain than it was under — in three years — than it was under eight years of the two of them, to put it nicely.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: Nine times more.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: Now, somebody lives — I have not heard the numbers or the statistics that you’re saying — but they’re making a tremendous amount of money.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: Economically, we saved it.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: And I saved it again a number of months ago when oil was crashing because of the pandemic.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: We saved it.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: We got — say what you want of that relationship, we got Saudi Arabia, Mexico and Russia to cut back, way back.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: We saved our oil industry and now it’s very vibrant and everybody has very inexpensive gasoline.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: Remember that.

transcript_turns.speaker: Joe Biden
transcript_turns.text: My response is that those people live on what they call ‘fence lines’.

transcript_turns.speaker: Joe Biden
transcript_turns.text: He doesn’t understand this.

transcript_turns.speaker: Joe Biden
transcript_turns.text: They live near chemical plants that, in fact, pollute.

transcript_turns.speaker: Joe Biden
transcript_turns.text: Chemical plants and oil plants and refineries that pollute.

transcript_turns.speaker: Joe Biden
transcript_turns.text: I used to live near that when I was growing up in Claymont, Delaware.

transcript_turns.speaker: Joe Biden
transcript_turns.text: And all the more oil refineries in Marcus Hook and the Delaware River than there is any place, including in Houston at the time.

transcript_turns.speaker: Joe Biden
transcript_turns.text: When my mom would get in the car when there were first frost to drive me to school, turned on the windshield wipers there’d be oil slick in the window.

transcript_turns.speaker: Joe Biden
transcript_turns.text: That’s why so many people in my state were dying and getting cancer.

transcript_turns.speaker: Joe Biden
transcript_turns.text: The fact is those frontline communities, it doesn’t matter what you’re paying them.

transcript_turns.speaker: Joe Biden
transcript_turns.text: It matters how you keep them safe.

transcript_turns.speaker: Joe Biden
transcript_turns.text: What do you do?

transcript_turns.speaker: Joe Biden
transcript_turns.text: And you impose restrictions on the pollutions, on the pollutants coming out of those fence line communities.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: Would he close down the oil industry — would you close down the oil industry?

transcript_turns.speaker: Joe Biden
transcript_turns.text: I would transition from the oil industry, yes.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: Oh, transition.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: That’s a big statement.

transcript_turns.speaker: Joe Biden
transcript_turns.text: It is a big statement because I would stop —

transcript_turns.speaker: Joe Biden
transcript_turns.text: Because the oil industry pollutes, significantly — but here’s the deal —

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: I see.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: That’s a big statement.

transcript_turns.speaker: Joe Biden
transcript_turns.text: Well, if you let me finish the statement, because it has to be replaced by renewable energy over time.

transcript_turns.speaker: Joe Biden
transcript_turns.text: Over time.

transcript_turns.speaker: Joe Biden
transcript_turns.text: And I’d stop giving to the oil industry — I’d stop giving them federal subsidies.

transcript_turns.speaker: Joe Biden
transcript_turns.text: You won’t give federal subsidies to the gas and, excuse me, to solar and wind.

transcript_turns.speaker: Joe Biden
transcript_turns.text: Why are we giving it to oil industry?

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: We actually do give it to solar and wind–

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: And that’s maybe the biggest statement in terms of business, that’s the biggest statement.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: Because basically what he’s saying is he is going to destroy the oil industry.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: Will you remember that Texas?

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: Will you remember that Pennsylvania?

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: Oklahoma?

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: Ohio?

transcript_turns.speaker: Joe Biden
transcript_turns.text: He takes everything out of context, but the point is, look, we have to move toward a net zero emissions.

transcript_turns.speaker: Joe Biden
transcript_turns.text: The first place to do that by the year 2035 is in energy production.

transcript_turns.speaker: Joe Biden
transcript_turns.text: By 2050, totally.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: Is he gonna get China to do it?

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: Is he going to get China to do it?

transcript_turns.speaker: Joe Biden
transcript_turns.text: No, I’m going to rejoin the Paris Accord and make China abide by what they agreed to.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: That’ll cost you $1 trillion.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: We have to make our country totally successful, as it was prior to the plague coming in from China.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: Now we’re rebuilding it and we’re doing record numbers, 11.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: 4 million jobs in a short period of time etc.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: But, I will tell you, go back before the plague came in, just before, I was getting calls from people that were not normally people that would call me.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: They wanted to get together.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: We had the best Black unemployment numbers in the history of our country, Hispanic, women, Asian, people with diplomas, with no diplomas, MIT graduates, number one in the class — everybody had the best numbers.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: And you know what?

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: The other side wanted to get together.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: They wanted to unify.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: Success is going to bring us together.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: We are on the road to success.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: But I’m cutting taxes and he wants to raise everybody’s taxes.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: And he wants to put new regulations on everything.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: He will kill it.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: If he gets in, you will have a depression, the likes of which you’ve never seen.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: Your 401K’s will go to hell and it’ll be a very, very sad day for this country.

transcript_turns.speaker: Joe Biden
transcript_turns.text: I will say, I’m an American president.

transcript_turns.speaker: Joe Biden
transcript_turns.text: I represent all of you whether you voted for me or against me.

transcript_turns.speaker: Joe Biden
transcript_turns.text: And I’m going to make sure that you’re represented.

transcript_turns.speaker: Joe Biden
transcript_turns.text: I’m going to give you hope.

transcript_turns.speaker: Joe Biden
transcript_turns.text: We’re going to move.

transcript_turns.speaker: Joe Biden
transcript_turns.text: We’re going to choose science over fiction.

transcript_turns.speaker: Joe Biden
transcript_turns.text: We’re going to choose hope over fear.

transcript_turns.speaker: Joe Biden
transcript_turns.text: We’re going to choose to move forward because we have enormous opportunities, enormous opportunities to make things better.

transcript_turns.speaker: Joe Biden
transcript_turns.text: We can grow this economy.

transcript_turns.speaker: Joe Biden
transcript_turns.text: We can deal with systemic racism.

transcript_turns.speaker: Joe Biden
transcript_turns.text: At the same time, we can make sure that our economy is being run, and moved, and motivated by clean energy, creating millions of new jobs.

transcript_turns.speaker: Joe Biden
transcript_turns.text: And that’s the fact, that’s what we’re going to do.

transcript_turns.speaker: Joe Biden
transcript_turns.text: And I’m going to say, as I said at the beginning, what is on the ballot here is the character of this country.

transcript_turns.speaker: Joe Biden
transcript_turns.text: Decency.

transcript_turns.speaker: Joe Biden
transcript_turns.text: Honor.

transcript_turns.speaker: Joe Biden
transcript_turns.text: Respect.

transcript_turns.speaker: Joe Biden
transcript_turns.text: Treating people with dignity.

transcript_turns.speaker: Joe Biden
transcript_turns.text: Making sure that everyone has an even chance.

transcript_turns.speaker: Joe Biden
transcript_turns.text: Now, I’m going to make sure you get that.

transcript_turns.speaker: Joe Biden
transcript_turns.text: You haven’t been getting it the last four years.
